evidence.reason: cmd_boot sets entered_boot before calling boot() but only records launched after boot() returns. If boot() raises after launching, the except path calls stop_owned_process(..., launched=None) after the lock has been released, so a retry can acquire the lock and the cleanup can stop the retry's guest instead of only the failed invocation's launch. This defeats the stated intent at lines 1293 and 1298-1299 and is an ordinary race/correctness defect in existing behavior.
